notes: FV Clipper: type how many seconds each cut should be, default 29, and one press turns a long clip on your timeline into a run of short ones, none of them longer than the length you set. A second press puts the same cuts in your Project panel as subclips named after the sequence and numbered in order, ready to select and export as a batch. Nothing is rendered and nothing is deleted. Run the installer, follow the pages, reopen Premiere.
